verdict.rationale: Blaxel sandboxes automatically scale to zero after about 5 seconds of inactivity, so idle sandboxes shut down without any developer action. Configurable expiration policies can also delete sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions, which gives developers explicit timeout control over sandbox lifetime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that compute billing stops during standby, evidence that the idle scale-to-zero threshold itself is configurable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
